audit.whatIsWrong: Disk chart handed Ornn levels 2, 3, first item and two items, but the prose on the same rows says the opposite: whys[1] 'shred a brittle, plate-less Ornn', whys[2] 'wins the level-3 all-in', whys[3] 'he can't punish you between trades', whys[5] 'is your peak'.
audit.why: The packet chart (Skill/Kled/Kled/Kled/Skill/Kled/Ornn) matches the prose exactly, including whys[4]'s 'It's even at 6', and fits 50.76%. Ornn only takes over once he stacks armour and free-upgrades items.
audit.corrected: Rows 1, 2, 3 and 5 flipped to Kled in both layers as one group; rows 0 and 4 stay Skill and row 6 stays Ornn.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level-6 spike was written as 'R double-knockup and W pillar'. There is no W pillar — Bellows Breath (W) is the Brittle breath, and the pillar comes from Volcanic Rupture (Q).
audit.why: It also buried the real spike. His threat is not the ult, it is that the Q pillar hands Searing Charge (E) a wall to collide with anywhere in the lane, so the knockup is available in open ground rather than only next to terrain.
audit.corrected: spikes[1].text rewritten to the Q-pillar-into-E combo as the actual knockup.
sources: champ-data/_kits/ornn.json (Q 'a magma pillar forms at the end location'; E 'If Ornn collides with terrain while charging, the impact creates a shockwave... knocks up'; W Bellows Breath)

audit.whatIsWrong: The pillar is attributed to E in five places ('E pillar knockup', 'bait his E pillar', 'his E pillar and R', 'Land E pillar into a wall', 'walls you off with E pillar') and to W in one.
audit.why: Q makes the pillar; E is the charge that hits it. Getting the slots backwards means a player watches the wrong cast and stands in exactly the wrong place — the pillar is the tell, and it appears on a 9s Q, not a 14s E.
audit.corrected: early, mid, late, spikes[1], spikes[3], whys[6] and wants.foe[0] rewritten with the correct slots and the Q-into-E sequence.

audit.whatIsWrong: Packet defect: Ornn's abilities are never named in the content layer — everything was 'his E', 'his W', 'his R'.
audit.why: Volcanic Rupture, Bellows Breath and Searing Charge are the real names and they are what the player sees on the enemy bar.
audit.corrected: Names written into early, mid and spikes[1].

audit.why: The trading advice — fight in open lane away from terrain, use the trap slow so he cannot disengage, Skaarl's bar as the trade buffer — is sound and matches the kits. Only the ability attributions inside it needed repair.

edits.before: Ornn's R double-knockup and W pillar can interrupt your R charge and peel your remount all-in.
edits.after: Volcanic Rupture's pillar gives Searing Charge a wall anywhere — that pair is the knockup, not his R.

edits.before: Ornn self-upgrades his items and walls you off with E pillar + R, out-scaling your frontloaded burst.
edits.after: Ornn self-upgrades his items and walls you off with Q pillars and R, out-scaling your frontloaded burst.

edits.before: Ornn self-upgrades items and stacks armor so your percent-HP burst stops mattering, while his E pillar and R wall you out late.
edits.after: Ornn self-upgrades items and stacks armour so your burst stops mattering, while his Q pillars and R wall you out of fights.

edits.before: Land E pillar into a wall or W brittle to knock you up and stat-check your dismount
edits.after: Drop a Q pillar, then Searing Charge into it so the collision knocks you up

edits.before: Ornn is brittle and immobile early with no sustain, so once your W is up at 2 and you have the full E-W-E re-E at 3, you out-trade him hard — his only answer is the E pillar knockup if he can shove you into terrain, so trade in open lane where he can't brittle-detonate you into a wall. Dodge his E (it knocks you up if it hits a wall behind you) and his W brittle proc, then commit. Your Q bear trap slows him so he can't walk away from your shots, and Skaarl's free health bar means you win every short trade he tries to start.
edits.after: Ornn is squishy and immobile early with no sustain, so once your W is up at 2 and you have the full E-W-E re-E at 3, you out-trade him hard — his answer is Volcanic Rupture's pillar, which hands Searing Charge a wall to slam you into anywhere in the lane. Fight away from that pillar and away from terrain, and step out of Bellows Breath's final gout so you never take a knockup while Brittle. Your Q bear trap slows him so he can't walk away from your shots, and Skaarl's free health bar wins every short trade he starts.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 stay yours as you stack W procs and remount through his poke-less kit — he simply can't punish you between trades. At 6 respect his R: the charging-ram double-knockup and a well-timed W pillar can interrupt your R charge or peel you off your all-in, so don't burn R into a lane where he can answer it — save it for ganks and roams. Keep forcing short trades; bait his E pillar, sidestep it, then E in, W-pull and Q-sweetspot him before plates.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 stay yours as you stack W procs and remount through his poke-less kit — he simply can't punish you between trades. At 6 respect his R: the charging-ram knockup and a fresh Volcanic Rupture pillar can interrupt your R charge or peel you off your all-in, so don't burn R into a lane where he can answer it — save it for ganks and roams. Keep forcing short trades; bait the pillar, walk wide of it, then E in, W shots and Q-sweetspot him before plates.

edits.before: This is where Ornn flips it. He self-upgrades his items for free and stacks armor, so your percent-HP Q and W on-hit shots stop carving him, while his E pillar and R double-knockup wall you out of every fight and lock your carries. Your frontloaded burst flattens as his durability spikes. Win the lane and snowball plates/kills before ~20 minutes with your first-item peak, because if it goes even into late, his teamfight CC and tankiness out-value your single-target all-in.
edits.after: This is where Ornn flips it. notes: Volcanic Rupture carries a derived 'grounding' flag but Riot's text describes only damage, a slow and the pillar — I wrote no claim that it denies Jousting or Chaaaaaaaarge!!!. Brittle's actual effect (what it does to the next immobilizing effect and to Ornn's damage) is not in Riot's W text either, so the page still says only 'become Brittle' — worth a dedicated line if the user can confirm the numbers.
